project.name: IndexMon
project.description: A Dockerized dashboard for monitoring indexer health by polling Prowlarr, Autobrr, and qBittorrent tracker status. Runs as a single container with nginx on port 80 proxying to an Express backend on port 3000, with a React frontend served via Vite. Computes downtime and uptime percentages, manages transition-only history in SQLite, and fires Apprise alerts on state changes.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: IndexMon is a Dockerized dashboard that polls Prowlarr, Autobrr, and qBittorrent to monitor indexer health. Start with the README and AGENTS.md to understand the architecture, endpoints, and quirks before diving into code.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: The project runs as a single Docker container (nginx :80 proxying to Express :3000) with SQLite persistence. docker-compose.yml loads env vars, the root Dockerfile uses a 3-stage build (frontend, backend, production), and CI/CD publishes to GHCR with screenshot capture on version tags.

tour.title: Backend Entrypoint & Express Setup
tour.description: server.ts is the application entrypoint — it generates or loads the admin password, starts background services (Autobrr definitions, qB polling, tracker stats), and fires up Express on port 3000 with graceful SIGTERM shutdown. app.ts wires the middleware stack: requestId, error handler, public routes (health, metrics, icons), then auth middleware, then API routes.

tour.title: Auth & Middleware Pipeline
tour.description: Auth uses an in-memory session Map with salted SHA-256 password verification. The authMiddleware validates Bearer tokens on protected routes. A global error handler catches unhandled exceptions, and the requestId middleware attaches a UUID + child logger to each request for traceability.

tour.title: API Routes
tour.description: Three route modules mount behind auth: /api/auth (rate-limited login, logout), /api/indexers (current status with inline service fetching, history with pagination clamped 1–5000), and /api/apprise/test (sends a test notification). Icon serving at /api/indexers/icon/:prowlarrId sits before auth middleware so browser tags can load favicons.

tour.title: Core Services — Indexer Health, Alerts & Background Polling
tour.description: The heart of the backend: indexer.ts fetches Prowlarr indexers (with health-check-based auto-disabled detection), Autobrr IRC networks, merges them via name normalization, computes transition-only history with time-weighted uptime %, fires Apprise alerts with dedup and configurable delay, and feeds Prometheus metrics. qbittorrent.ts handles cookie-based auth with 403 re-auth and domain-suffix matching. definitions.ts syncs Autobrr indexer definitions from GitHub. tracker-stats.ts queries UNIT3D APIs for per-indexer stats.

tour.title: Frontend Entry & Data Flow
tour.description: React mounts via frontend/index.html (with dark mode inline script) → main.tsx wraps the app in QueryClientProvider, AuthProvider, and ErrorBoundary. Routes.tsx defines /login (public) and / (protected via ProtectedRoute). DashboardPage uses the useIndexers hook (TanStack Query polling /api/indexers every 15s) and AuthContext (token in localStorage) to drive the UI.

tour.title: Frontend Components & Types
tour.description: IndexerTable renders a responsive table (desktop table, mobile cards) with color-coded status cells, buffer display, and uptime tooltips. StatusGrid shows an alphabetically-sorted grid of tiles with pop-in animations and state-change highlighting. CollapsibleSection persists open/closed state to localStorage. Shared types (Indexer, QbitStatus, ServicesStatus) define the data contracts between API and UI.
